company.name: SOGNDAL IDRETTSLAG FOTBALL
company.summary: SOGNDAL IDRETTSLAG FOTBALL is an association (forening/lag/innretning) registered under aktiviteter i idrettslag og -klubber (NACE 93.120), based in Sogndal, founded 1999-02-18. Its verified website describes it as: “Sogndalsakademiet er eit fritidstilbod for barn og unge mellom 6 og 12 år. Breiddefotballen” Public brand: SOGNDAL FOTBALL. Registered activity: Idrettslag - fotball. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue NOK 65.8 m, operating result NOK 2.0 m, net result NOK 1.5 m, total assets NOK 42.3 m, equity NOK 16.8 m. The period closed with a profit. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from NOK 78.1 m to NOK 65.8 m (-16%); net result went from NOK 9.2 m to NOK 1.5 m (-84%); equity went from NOK 15.3 m to NOK 16.8 m (+10%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin 3.0%; equity ratio 39.8%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 59. Leadership in the official register: Ingrid Narum (managing director); Egil Blaaflat Mundal (chair of the board); Jan Trygve Tollefsen (board member); Marie Tefre Birkeland (board member); plus 4 further roles. 1 registered workplace in Sogndal. Official website https://www.sogndalfotball.no (identity check: registry declared homepage); company-linked profiles on facebook, instagram, x. Latest company-published activity: “Før Sogndal–Hødd: Gratis inngang med drakt eller skjerf” (2026-11-04). Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-11-12). Not established from checked sources: active job ads (not available). Missing information is not treated as zero.
